purpose: Emphasize that something is not true at all.
keywords: express feelings speak politely show respect
This chair is not comfortable at all.
Even after reading the explanation, I do not understand at all.
She is not bothered by the mistake at all.
restrictions: Normally pairs with a negative expression.
mistake: Do not combine it with an ordinary positive predicate.
